description: Source code for a Git-related utility handling HTTP push operations, including DAV protocol interactions, lock management, and object transfer requests.

methods.name: xml_entities
methods.description: Converts a string to XML-quoted entities.

methods.name: curl_setup_http_get
methods.description: Configures a CURL handle for an HTTP GET request with custom method.

methods.name: curl_setup_http
methods.description: Configures a CURL handle for an HTTP request with specified method and data.

methods.name: get_dav_token_headers
methods.description: Generates DAV token headers based on lock and options.

methods.name: finish_request
methods.description: Handles completion of a transfer request based on its state.

methods.name: release_request
methods.description: Removes and frees a transfer request from the queue.

methods.name: process_response
methods.description: Callback to process HTTP response and finalize request.

methods.name: start_fetch_loose
methods.description: Initiates fetching a loose object from remote.

methods.name: start_mkcol
methods.description: Starts MKCOL request to create remote directory.

methods.name: start_fetch_packed
methods.description: Starts fetching a packed object from remote.

methods.name: start_put
methods.description: Starts uploading an object to remote via PUT.

methods.name: start_move
methods.description: Starts moving a remote object.

methods.name: refresh_lock
methods.description: Refreshes a DAV lock to keep it active.

methods.name: check_locks
methods.description: Checks and refreshes all active locks.

methods.name: get_remote_object_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of objects in a remote directory.

methods.name: add_fetch_request
methods.description: Adds a fetch request for an object if not local or fetching.

methods.name: add_send_request
methods.description: Adds a request to send (push) an object to remote.

methods.name: fetch_indices
methods.description: Fetches pack indices from remote.

methods.name: one_remote_object
methods.description: Marks an object as remote, fetches if needed.

methods.name: handle_lockprop_ctx
methods.description: Handles XML parsing of lock properties.

methods.name: handle_new_lock_ctx
methods.description: Handles XML parsing of new lock info.

methods.name: xml_start_tag
methods.description: XML start tag handler.

methods.name: xml_end_tag
methods.description: XML end tag handler.

methods.name: xml_cdata
methods.description: XML character data handler.

methods.name: lock_remote
methods.description: Creates a remote lock via DAV.

methods.name: unlock_remote
methods.description: Releases a remote lock.

methods.name: remove_locks
methods.description: Removes all remote locks.

methods.name: remove_locks_on_signal
methods.description: Signal handler to remove locks on termination.

methods.name: remote_ls
methods.description: Performs a DAV PROPFIND to list remote directory contents.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_from_objpath
methods.description: Extracts object ID from sharded object path.

methods.name: process_ls_object
methods.description: Processes a directory listing object.

methods.name: process_ls_ref
methods.description: Processes a reference listing.

methods.name: handle_remote_ls_ctx
methods.description: Handles XML parsing context for remote listing.

methods.name: get_dav_remote_heads
methods.description: Fetches remote heads (refs) via DAV.

methods.name: add_remote_info_ref
methods.description: Adds remote ref info to local list.

methods.name: update_remote_info_refs
methods.description: Updates remote server info refs.

methods.name: remote_exists
methods.description: Checks if a remote path exists.

methods.name: fetch_symref
methods.description: Fetches symbolic ref or object ID for remote.

methods.name: verify_merge_base
methods.description: Verifies merge base between local and remote.

methods.name: delete_remote_branch
methods.description: Deletes a remote branch after validation.

methods.name: run_request_queue
methods.description: Runs queued transfer requests.
